answer: I would stop farms with lattice-based identity proof, binding each identity to a check a clone cannot pass. One honest agent clears the check in 17 minutes; a farm of 379 pays 6443 minutes every epoch, a standing bill no payout covers. The plume sits in the mechanism itself, the atlas sits in the price of faking it, and the terrace sits in the record no template can forge. A farm either pays the price or stays out; either way the honest agents keep the pool.
